# isaac-mcp — full reference (llms.txt points here)

NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab simulation via MCP. GPU-accelerated PhysX physics, USD
scenes, file-protocol job isolation. 18 tools (10 sim + 5 AI + 3 Prefab).

## Sim tools (9)

- sim_status() — health: isaac_available, isaac_version, isaac_python, gpus[],
  scenes_dir_exists, scenes_in_depot, active_jobs, jobs_dir_exists.
- load_scene(uri, name) — copy/download USD/URDF/SDF/STL/STEP into scenes depot.
- spawn_model(uri, name, scene="") — copy a model into a scene's models/ dir.
- start_sim(scene_name, headless=True) — launch Isaac Sim subprocess, returns
  job_id (poll get_state/list_jobs; first launch pulls extensions, 10+ min).
- stop_sim(job_id) — touch stop.signal + terminate the runner.
- get_state(job_id) — state.json: time, step, qpos, qvel, actuator_values.
- apply_control(job_id, ctrl) — write control.json {actuator: value}.
- list_scenes() / list_jobs() — depot registry / active+completed jobs.
- isaac_shutdown(confirmed=True) — stop sims, terminate server (MCP).

## AI tools (5, ctx.sample with Ollama fallback on 127.0.0.1:11434)

- agentic_sim_workflow(goal, ctx) — plan + narrate a multi-step sim workflow.
- natural_language_control(prompt, job_id, ctx) — NL to actuator JSON.
- analyze_sim_state(job_id, ctx) — posture/stability NL report.
- analyze_sim_logs(job_id, ctx) — root-cause from error.txt + runner.log tail.
- discover_model(description, ctx) — LLM GitHub raw URLs, download into depot.

## REST (FastAPI :11049; frontend Vite :11048)

- GET /health, /api/health, /api/status (sim_status), /api/capabilities
- GET /api/scenes, POST /api/scenes/load {uri, name}
- GET /api/simulations, POST /api/jobs/start {scene_name, headless?},
  POST /api/jobs/{id}/stop, POST /api/shutdown (orderly exit for launcher)
- GET /api/skills (skills/*/SKILL.md), GET /api/v1/diagnostics (CUA-NSIS)
- GET /api/fleet/apps (fleet registry discovery, live-self badge)
- AI: POST /api/ai/workflow|nl-control|analyze-state|analyze-logs|discover-model
- LLM: GET /api/llm/providers|discover|models|onboarding, POST /api/llm/chat
- Logs: GET /api/logs|/stats|/export, DELETE /api/logs. MCP HTTP mounted /mcp.

## Config (see .env.example)

ISAAC_SIM_PATH (install root), ISAAC_PYTHON (3.11 interpreter override),
ISAAC_MCP_SCENES_DIR (default ./scenes/), ISAAC_MCP_JOBS_DIR (default ./jobs/),
ISAAC_MCP_HOST/ISAAC_MCP_PORT (default 127.0.0.1:11049).

## Layout

- src/isaac_mcp/server.py — 18 MCP tools (+ prefab_cards.py); _sim_runner.py — Isaac subprocess
  (file protocol: metadata.json, state.json, control.json, stop.signal,
  completed.txt, error.txt, runner.log)
- web_sota/backend/server.py — FastAPI; web_sota/src/ — 11 React pages (single Chat: Ask answers, Act runs sim tools via /api/chat/agent)
- native/ — Tauri shell (backend 11049); scenes/, jobs/ — runtime data
- Skills: skills/isaac/SKILL.md (served via GET /api/skills)

## Commands

- uv run python -m isaac_mcp — MCP stdio server
- .\web_sota\start.ps1 — full dashboard (fleet engine + standalone fallback)
- uv run pytest tests/ -q — tests (coverage gate --cov-fail-under=40)
- uv run ruff check src/ web_sota/backend/ — lint (T20 print-ban enforced)
